title: Plux segment document
description: A named audience: a rule over the attributes of a device, its build and its user, evaluated by rollouts on the server and by flags and experiments on the device (REL-051, ABT-001, ABT-006). File: `segments/<key>.segment.json`.

segmentOperator.description: How a condition compares an attribute with its value: equality, membership in a list, or an ordering on numbers and versions.

segmentRule.description: One condition (`attribute`, `operator`, `value`) or a group of rules combined with `all` (every rule holds) or `any` (at least one holds). The compiler checks the attribute, the operator and the value (PLX-1704).

attribute.description: A targeting attribute: `build`, `runtimeVersion`, `os`, `osVersion`, `deviceClass`, `locale`, `region`, `channel`, or `user.<name>` for an attribute of the user context.

value.description: The value to compare with: a string, a number, a boolean or, for `in` and `notIn`, a list of them.
